criteria.description: A new book opens at the bodymatter landmark, not the cover
→ turns to the next page
← turns to the previous page
Page keys also work with focus on the app window
Space turns forward, ⇧Space back
PgDn / ↓ forward, PgUp / ↑ back
Margin clicks turn pages (right = next, left = previous)
The click that activates the window never turns a page
A click inside the text column never turns a page
One wheel roll (native, not precise) turns one page
One trackpad gesture turns one page; its momentum does not
More than 3 pages in under 1 s offers “Back to page N”
Back (⌘[) returns to where the rapid turning started
The position is saved within the 1 s debounce
Quitting saves the position at once, inside the 1 s debounce
Leaving for the library and reopening restores the same place
Resizing the window keeps the reading position on screen
In a right-to-left book, ← turns to the next page
In a right-to-left book, the left margin moves forward
A fixed-layout book opens and turns pages (one view, scaled to fit)
A 1 MB+ chapter opens within the open-book budget (< 500 ms, click → first location)
criteria.evidence: opened in 2353 ms (886 pages in the first section)

criteria.description: A page turn is announced briefly to screen readers (“Page N”)
A book font that fails to load falls back to Literata without a prompt
Open a book to its first page in < 500 ms (§6.4; click → first location, median and p95 of 5)
Reflow after a resize: < 150 ms from the end of the 120 ms debounce to the page (§6.4)
Leaving the reader closes the engine and removes its views, even for a short book
Page turns render within a frame: < 16 ms p95, within and across chapters (§6.4)
Hostile book content stays inert in the product reader (Spike E, L14)
